items.metric: LIVE GMV (week Sep 14 to 20, third week of decline, largest fall in the set)
items.effect: 103 streams produced 370.60, or 3.60 per stream against 18.06 in the prior week, so live is a yield problem rather than a scheduling one.
items.action: Re-brief the creators holding the top streams and hold stream count near last week's 103 instead of adding volume.

items.effect: Affiliate share of GMV is 61.8% and shrinking faster than the shop total, so the creator channel is the contracting input.
items.action: Move the 19 approved and 3 ready-to-ship samples into shipment today, since affiliate GMV follows sample delivery by one to two weeks.

items.metric: Collab invites sent (third week of decline, upstream of sampling)
items.effect: Invites halved while 9,585 DMs were sent, so outbound reach is contracting before the reply, sample and content stages.
items.action: Restore invite volume toward the prior week's 12,221 using the existing outreach lists before changing message content.

items.metric: GMV (week Sep 14 to 20, fourth consecutive decline, 10 metrics in three-week runs)
items.effect: The week closed at 600.06 GMV per day against 1,030.93, and orders, units, video views, DMs, invites and samples delivered are all in three-week runs.
items.action: Track the Sep 21 to 27 week against the 600.06 daily run and keep sample approvals and shipping moving as the only levers that reach October GMV.

items.metric: Sample requests (third week of decline, rejection rate 53.0%)
items.effect: Requests fell 47.3% while 159 of 300 requests are rejected and 27 sit in To Review, so more than half of inbound sample demand never reaches a shipment.
items.action: Clear the 27 pending reviews today, highest post rate first, before the 3 expiring Sep 22 and 12 by Sep 24 lapse.

items.metric: GMV Max Back to School campaign ROAS against its 5.4 target
items.effect: The campaign spent 289.56 for 83.97 of revenue, a 205.59 loss before commission and COGS, on 3 orders at 96.52 each.
items.action: Pause or reallocate the 289.56 of weekly spend into Screen Door at 2.007, the only campaign clear of breakeven and nearest its target.
